node.statement: Invoke the external lem-stage1-rectified-cstar-control and existentially instantiate its universal witnesses as constants c >= 1 and e in (0, 1/c]. Thus every finite-dimensional epsilon_X-C*-algebra with 0 <= epsilon_X <= e admits, on the same involutive normed space, a bilinear product bold-dot and J = J^dagger satisfying every exact-unit alpha-C*-algebra axiom of def-epsilon-cstar-algebra, including ||J|| = 1, for alpha = c*epsilon_X, together with ||J-I_X|| <= c*epsilon_X and ||x bold-dot y-xy|| <= c*epsilon_X*||x||*||y|| for all x,y.
